code:
Hypothesis: If payment-integration's gateway
calls exceed 2 seconds, checkout-api's circuit
breaker opens within 10s and falls back to
"pay on delivery" instead of hanging.

Steady state required first:
  checkout success rate >= 99.5%
  p95 payment latency < 800ms
caption: A chaos experiment is an experiment -- no hypothesis, no way to say afterward what was actually learned.

code:
abort_if:
  - checkout_success_rate < 98%
  - any_order_charged_twice: true
  - manual_abort_signal: "#chaos-room"
max_blast_radius: "5% of traffic, canary only"
rollback: "Remove fault rule, revert in 30s"
caption: Decided in advance so nobody has to argue, mid-incident, about whether to stop.
